summary: Limit the BuildKit-only Dockerfile check to repository Dockerfiles, skipping untracked scratch and output trees (.cache, .git, dist, vendor, node_modules), so a stale extracted source copy cannot fail it (BUG-0194). API impact: none — test-only.

api.reason: API impact: none. Only a repository check's file selection changes.

verification.method: The test passes with the stale .cache copy present and still fails for a temporary tracked Dockerfile using COPY --chmod; full python unittest discovery.
